verdict: Meta delivered a lead surge; Google spend accountability is being fixed now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 19 tracked leads at a cost of $160.63 per lead — all 19 attributed to Meta, which drove a 250% week-over-week spike in lead volume. Google Ads consumed $2,257.98 this period, but conversion tracking is being repaired, so that spend is not yet accountable to any measurable result. Separately, 82 pipeline contacts were created but none converted to booked appointments, which points to an intake routing issue rather than an ads volume problem — that process is being corrected now. Google Ads tracking and the intake workflow are the two active priorities this week; expect cleaner attribution and improved lead-to-appointment rates in next week's report.
